description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Seraph Mode I (Cid Raines)] and [Dark/Holy Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Seraph Mode I (Cid Raines)
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Holy abilities trigger 2 additional times, casts Dual Seraph-Wing Buffet after using equipped Dark or Holy abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Seraph Mode II (Cid Raines)], removes [Dual Awoken Seraph Mode I (Cid Raines)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Seraph Mode II (Cid Raines)
description.text: Increase the damage/healing cap by 10000, Dark and Holy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, grants [Dark/Holy Ability +10% Boost 1]/[Dark/Holy Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using 1/2/3+ Dark or Holy abilities

description.name: Dark/Holy Ability +10% Boost 1
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 10% more damage

description.name: Dark/Holy Ability +20% Boost 1
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 20% more damage

description.name: Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: Dual Seraph-Wing Buffet
description.text: Two single attacks (4.14 each), grants [Quick Cast 1] to the user, grants [Dark/Holy Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user if the user's Doom timer is below 20, causes [Doom Timer -1] to the user if the user's Doom timer is below 20

description.name: Double Crystarium Mode II (Holy, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Holy/Dark ability

description.name: Dark/Holy Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Dark and Holy abilities deal 5% more damage
